scope: Biological model boundaries and public aggregate population validation. Sources support scoped claims, not clinical predictive accuracy.

sources.title: The ABO blood group
sources.container: Blood Groups and Red Cell Antigens, Chapter 5
sources.location: Background information / History; Basic biochemistry; Molecular information / The H locus (FUT1)
supports: A/B/O is a simplified three-allele model with six diploid genotypes and four common phenotypes
A and B are codominant over O
Variant ABO alleles and H-antigen dependence limit the simple phenotype map
does_not_support: Universal genotype frequencies inferred from a blood-donor phenotype table
Complete molecular ABO state coverage or clinical transfusion recommendations
sources.reuse: Cited paraphrase only; no source illustrations or complete chapter reproduced. Historical chapter is used for stable mechanisms, not current antigen counts.

sources.title: The Rh blood group
sources.container: Blood Groups and Red Cell Antigens, Chapter 7
sources.location: Introduction; Basic biochemistry / Common Rh phenotypes; Uncommon Rh phenotypes; Molecular information
supports: RHD and RHCE are closely linked and structurally complex
Deletion, pseudogene and hybrid alleles can yield D-negative phenotypes
Weak and partial D variants exist
does_not_support: D/d is a complete molecular model of the Rh system
Current antigen inventory or current weak-D clinical practice
sources.reuse: Cited mechanistic paraphrase only; avoid using dated clinical guidance.

sources.title: The Hh blood group
sources.container: Blood Groups and Red Cell Antigens, Chapter 6
sources.location: Basic biochemistry; Uncommon H Phenotypes; Molecular information
supports: FUT1 supplies the H-antigen precursor needed for erythrocyte A/B antigen production
Two inactive FUT1 copies can mask A/B expression
FUT2 and partial H variants create additional phenotype distinctions
does_not_support: An hh O-like red-cell phenotype is clinically interchangeable with ordinary ABO O
The exact toy 7/16 result is a measured population frequency
sources.reuse: Cited paraphrase. The 3/16,3/16,3/16,7/16 toy cross is newly derived from explicit independent-locus assumptions.

sources.title: The MNS blood group
sources.container: Blood Groups and Red Cell Antigens, Chapter 12
sources.location: Antigens of the MNS blood group / Molecular basis; Molecular information / The GYPA locus
supports: GYPA M and N alleles are codominant
The wider MNS system includes GYPB, linked loci, recombination and variant alleles
does_not_support: The M/N biallelic teaching model covers all MNS phenotypes
sources.reuse: Cited paraphrase only; do not reuse historical antigen totals as current counts.

sources.title: Sickle Cell Disease
sources.location: GeneReview Scope; Diagnosis; Genetic Counseling / Mode of Inheritance and Risk to Family Members
supports: Sickle cell disease includes HbS homozygosity and compound heterozygosity with other HBB pathogenic variants
A two-allele A/S model cannot encode all sickling disorders
Genotype transmission alone does not predict clinical severity

sources.title: NM_000518.5(HBB):c.20A>T (p.Glu7Val), ClinVar VCV000015333.7
sources.location: Variant Details / HGVS, Protein change, Other names, Links
supports: rs334 HbS corresponds to GRCh38 NC_000011.10:g.5227002T>A and HBB c.20A>T
p.Glu7Val and legacy Glu6Val/E6V nomenclature refer to HbS
does_not_support: T at rs334 excludes other pathogenic HBB variants
The stored reference-panel samples have clinical phenotype labels
sources.reuse: Variant identifiers and cited summary only.

sources.title: A Note on Exact Tests of Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium
sources.location: Exact probability-ordering test and conditional distribution of heterozygote counts
supports: A conditional exact HWE test is preferable to unqualified asymptotic chi-square testing with rare alleles
HWE departures can reflect structure, genotyping error or affected-sample ascertainment
A probability-ordering two-sided P value sums all feasible tables no more probable than the observed table
sources.reuse: Mathematical method independently implemented; no source code copied. Article is cited, not reproduced.

sources.title: Mendelian Proportions in a Mixed Population
sources.location: Original two-page derivation; bibliographic record independently verified via PubMed
supports: Historical origin of the random-mating genotype-proportion result
sources.reuse: Bibliographic attribution; equations in the project are freshly derived.

sources.title: High mortality from Plasmodium falciparum malaria in children living with sickle cell anemia on the coast of Kenya
sources.location: Table 1 (XML table-wrap id T1); Study participants; Sampling and laboratory methods; Results; Table 3
supports: Genotype-dependent disease associations make constant universal reproductive selection assumptions inappropriate
The publication's own table/narrative discrepancies require an explicit source audit
sources.observed_counts_status: Rejected as the clean benchmark CSV: Table 1 controls 1252/218/10,n1480 conflict with narrative n1479; SCA is not exclusively molecularly confirmed HbSS

sources.title: A global reference for human genetic variation
sources.location: Main text / Human genetic variation in more than 2,500 individuals; Supplementary Table 1 for population descriptions
supports: Phase 3 reference panel contains 2504 individuals from 26 populations
Sequencing, arrays, genotype inference and statistical phasing generated the calls
A diversity reference panel is not a census or a clinical prediction validation set
sources.reuse: Underlying 1000 Genomes data are available without publication embargo; cite project and data provider, subject to IGSR/EMBL-EBI terms.

supports: Frozen CSV contains 26 nonoverlapping component populations and 2504 calls
Counts are TT2367,TA137,AA0 after denominator-verified zero completion
Genomic A allele count137 of5008; genomic T4871 of5008

sources.title: Sample Collection Principles
supports: Project sample-collection principles specify adults
Open genomic use and population comparisons were part of the consent framework
The dataset is not a clinical phenotype cohort

sources.title: Mapping Genomes
sources.location: Genetic mapping / The principles of genetic mapping; Figures 5.15-5.18
supports: Parental phase and meiotic recombination determine linked-locus gamete combinations
Recombination fractions and physical distance are distinct; crossovers are not spatially uniform
does_not_support: A supplied synthetic recombination fraction is measured for a real locus pair
Unlinked segregation proves population-level linkage equilibrium
